is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles funestus sensu lato (including An. funestus s.s., An. rivulorum, and An. leesoni) in Mopeia, Mozambique (page 1, 3, 6).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study assays Rdl A296S (A296S-Rdl), Cyp6p9a/b 6.5kb-SV (6.5 kb SV insertion), and GSTe2 L119F (L119F-GSTe2) (page 4-7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 gives exact genotype counts (SS=9, RR=7, RS=108) and allele frequencies for Rdl in An. funestus s.s. and other species. Page 7 reports exact genotype counts for the 6.5 kb SV insertion (69 SV+/SV+, 1 SV-/SV-, 11 SV+/SV-) and L119F-GSTe2 (37 homozygous susceptible, 4 heterozygous).

african_field_population.evidence: Adults and larvae were collected from 15 sentinel sites across Mopeia District, Zambezia Province, Mozambique between October 2021 and September 2022 (pages 1, 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article reporting original entomological field collections, bioassays, and molecular genotyping.

sub_country_location.evidence: Field samples were collected from Mopeia District, Zambezia Province, Mozambique across 15 sentinel clusters shown on a map (pages 1, 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected between October 2021 and September 2022 (page 1, 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study was conducted in the context of the BOHEMIA clinical trial (page 3), but the mosquito collections and insecticide resistance genotyping data represent primary reporting.

supplement.evidence: All genotype counts, allele frequencies, and bioassay data are fully reported in the main text and Table 2.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated phenotypic resistance to bendiocarb, DDT, deltamethrin, and pirimiphos-methyl using WHO tube bioassays with PBO synergism in Anopheles funestus s.l. from Mopeia District, Zambezia Province, Mozambique (collected October 2021 - September 2022). Genotyping of 210 mosquitoes provided extractable genotype counts and allele frequencies for Rdl A296S, Cyp6p9a/b 6.5kb-SV, and GSTe2 L119F.
